adjudication_layer_SECONDARY_not_in_mech.ambiguous_shared_gene_rationale: G yields a REDUCED product in its missense_residual disease but a TOXIC product in its null disease (e.g. HBB: beta-thalassaemia reduced vs sickle-cell toxic HbS); a single Hb 'positive modulator' surfaced for the null row may be DETOXIFYING the toxic variant (consistent with the kit's CLEAR direction) rather than RESTORING a reduced one -> NOT counted as a firm miss.
adjudication_layer_SECONDARY_not_in_mech.firm_over_exclusion_rationale: G appears ONLY as a null lesion -> its product is reduced in this disease and an independently-annotated restorer/potentiator/cofactor for that product exists -> the kit's conservative LOF_null under-admitted a feasible gamma-restore [O]; logged as an honest miss for a FUTURE Track-A re-derivation, NOT auto-corrected here.
adjudication_layer_SECONDARY_not_in_mech.mechanical_rule_no_hand_judging: a raw null-set restore-hit on primary_gene G is FIRM over-exclusion iff G does NOT also appear as a primary_gene in the LOF_missense_residual set; it is AMBIGUOUS (shared-gene) iff G appears in BOTH sets.
adjudication_layer_SECONDARY_not_in_mech.principle: the mechanical numerator is the RAW classifier (no adjudication baked in). A SEPARATE, MECHANICAL, per-candidate adjudication then distinguishes a FIRM gamma-restore OVER-EXCLUSION from an AMBIGUOUS shared-gene hit, with each agent's mechanism shown.
adjudication_layer_SECONDARY_not_in_mech.reported_both_ways: calibration is reported RAW (classifier-only) AND FIRM (after the shared-gene rule). The reader sees the unmassaged result and the mechanical interpretation separately.

CONTEXT_GOF_gamma_restore_EXCLUDED_by_di.role: gamma-restore is excluded for GOF by DIRECTION (product is gained, not lost), a different logic from absence-of-corrector. Reported for completeness; NOT in the calibration numerator.

POSITIVE_CONTROL_LOF_missense_residual_g.role: the kit asserts a corrector IS known (residual_allele_evidence=True). The classifier SHOULD fire here. Detection rate here is the test's sensitivity; the CONTRAST null-vs-positive-control is the validity signal.

TARGET_LOF_null_gamma_restore_EXCLUDED.claim_under_test: for each, the kit asserts NO corrector/chaperone/read-through/potentiator is known -> a raw classifier HIT here is a candidate MISS (over-exclusion).

disease_partition_frozen.rule: partition is deterministic from the frozen `lesion` field; NO hand-picking. Join key = primary_gene (the promoter-gamma-bearing locus the exclusion is about).

EXCLUDED_action_types_not_gamma_restore.AGONIST: receptor agonism = downstream supply, not restoration of the mutant's folding
EXCLUDED_action_types_not_gamma_restore.EXOGENOUS GENE: gene therapy -- supplies the gene, not a cusp gamma-axis chaperone
EXCLUDED_action_types_not_gamma_restore.EXOGENOUS PROTEIN: enzyme/protein replacement -- supplies the product exogenously
EXCLUDED_action_types_not_gamma_restore.INHIBITOR / BLOCKER / ANTAGONIST / ANTIS: clearing/opposing -> the CLEAR family, never gamma-restore

gamma_restore_classifier_FROZEN.definition: a (drug,gene)-edge mechanism counts as a gamma-RESTORE lever iff it RESTORES/POTENTIATES/FOLDS the lesioned gene's own (residual) product -- i.e. supplies competence THROUGH the mutant protein, the cusp gamma-axis -- as opposed to clearing/opposing load or supplying the product exogenously.
gamma_restore_classifier_FROZEN.known_under_detection_stated: read-through agents (e.g. ataluren) act on the ribosome and are NOT annotated on the disease gene's edge, so the gene-edge join CANNOT see them; positive-control sensitivity is therefore < 1. Consequence: corrector-detection is CONSERVATIVE -> calibration is an UPPER bound and any HIT found is robust; additional unseen over-exclusions may exist.

why_this_round: For every LOF_null disease the kit EXCLUDES the gamma-restore lever family. That exclusion is an
ASSERTION inherited from §3.1: lesion=LOF_missense_residual (and gamma-restore ADMITTED) iff a
corrector / pharmacological chaperone / read-through / potentiator is KNOWN for the gene (a
chaperonable/residual allele demonstrably exists), recorded as residual_allele_evidence=True; else
the conservative LOF_null call sets residual_allele_evidence=False and gamma-restore is EXCLUDED.
V1-V9 tested only the kit's POSITIVE direction predictions (V1 circularity, V2 emergence, V3-V8
external direction/rediscovery) and its level/shape inheritance (V9). The 108 EXCLUSION claims have
never been falsification-tested. V10 tests them against an independently-assembled corrector source
and reports MISSES (a null gene for which a gamma-restore-type agent in fact exists).
